fishing: WHEN: Friday evening Oct 9. Boca Grande low about 6:18p, next high about 12:33a Sat. Solunar very high (coeff 95); major window about 11:24a-1:24p already passed. Small craft advisory through Saturday afternoon. S 15-20 kt, choppy, storms this afternoon — pass and Gulf better early Saturday. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/9 — tarpon and snook hanging in Gasparilla Pass; small mangrove snapper and grunts on the trestle. Waterline ~Oct 6: Spanish mackerel off the beach, snook in the passes. Cooks Sportsland Venice (earlier): whiting, some snook and redfish off the beach; shrimp or sandfleas on the step-off at high tide. LEMON BAY: Fishin Franks 10/9 — mangrove snapper at Chadwick Park Pier, snook expected on the pilings, redfish and small snook on random docks. West Wall / McCall Flats: no fresh reports, redfish expected on the lower half. Waterline / Fine Bait: Bull and Turtle Bay reds, smaller snook and trout; some reds on the West Wall. NEARSHORE: Fishin Franks — weather not conducive to reports this week. Waterline Oct 6: cobia schools migrating, mangrove snapper inside 20 miles and on nearshore wrecks; gag grouper season open. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters still no October bite note (last site report June 11). Baits: live shrimp, sandfleas, soft plastics, cut bait, small white paddletails.
redtide: FWC Oct 9: K. brevis background to very low in 11 Gulf samples. SWFL background Pinellas and Manatee, background to very low in and offshore Sarasota, background and very low Charlotte, background offshore Collier. No fish kills, no respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 16.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 10/5 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/9). Englewood Beach GOOD, latest listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
fpl: Evening county feed: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 (usoutage FPL snapshot dated 2026-10-09). No Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
